e.title: 西孟加拉洪水巨灾模型：整个仓库就是一份 Excel 工作簿，含 MDR 矩阵、成数再保引擎与 EP 曲线
e.title_en: A West Bengal flood catastrophe model whose entire repository is one Excel workbook, with an MDR matrix, an excess-of-loss engine and an EP curve
e.title_hk: 西孟加拉洪水巨災模型：整個倉庫就是一份 Excel 工作簿，含 MDR 矩陣、超額賠款再保引擎與 EP 曲線
e.summary: 一个用「进阶 Excel」搭起来的端到端财产险巨灾模型：对西孟加拉 1,000 处合成房产模拟地坪以上洪水损失，用二维平均损失率矩阵处理水深与建筑等级的组合，再套上 5% 保额免赔与自留额／条约限额的结构，并用 LARGE 数组排名与经验概率公式画出净自留损失的超额概率曲线
e.summary_hk: 一個用「進階 Excel」搭起來的端到端財產險巨災模型：對西孟加拉 1,000 處合成房產模擬地坪以上洪水損失，用二維平均損失率矩陣處理水深與建築等級的組合，再套上 5% 保額免賠與自留額／條約限額的結構，並用 LARGE 陣列排名與經驗概率公式畫出淨自留損失的超額概率曲線
e.summary_en: An end-to-end property catastrophe model built in Advanced Excel: it simulates ground-up flood losses for 1,000 synthetic properties in West Bengal, applies a two-dimensional mean damage ratio matrix to combinations of flood depth and construction class, layers a 5%-of-TIV deductible with retention and treaty limits on top, and draws an exceedance probability curve of net retained loss using LARGE array ranking and the empirical Rank/(N+1) probability formula
e.body:
**west-bengal-flood-cat-model** 是一个**用进阶 Excel 搭起来的端到端财产险洪水巨灾模型**（仓库 `Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、语言实测为 `None`（即 GitHub 未识别出主语言）、仓库体量 704 KB、创建于 2026-09-07、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 4,300 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把假设写成可核对的东西」**中的**第二种，也是载体最出人意料的一种：它的模型本体就是一份 Excel 工作簿**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**仓库描述逐字**：**「Stochastic Catastrophe Flood Model for a synthetic West Bengal P&C portfolio」**。⭐⭐⭐ **根目录实测只有两项**：**`README.md`（4,300 字节）与 **`West_Bengal_Flood_Catastrophe_Model.xlsx`（294,582 字节）****——**即**这个仓库里没有代码，模型本体就是那份工作簿****；**GitHub 因此未识别出主语言（实测为 `None`）**。**README 开篇逐字**：**「Architecting an end-to-end Property & Casualty (P&C) catastrophe model in **Advanced Excel**. This project simulates ground-up flood losses for a **synthetic portfolio of 1,000 properties** across highly exposed districts in West Bengal, bridging theoretical actuarial concepts into an automated risk engine.」**。

**其四个阶段逐字实测**：**① 暴露数据工程（Phase 1）**——用 Excel 动态数组（`SEQUENCE`、`NORM.INV`、`RANDBETWEEN`）生成暴露数据；**用嵌套 `IFS` 施加「逻辑受限的风险组合」**（**逐字举例：强制工业用途只能登记为 `Pucca` 结构类型并对应高端重置价值**）；**纳入地坪高度（英尺）与楼层数以刻画地面淹没**；**总保额（TIV）按建筑等级以正态分布围绕现实重置成本建模**。**② 灾害目录与脆弱性矩阵（Phase 2）**——**硬编码具有代表性的随机洪水事件，含重现期、年概率与最大水深**；**建一个二维平均损失率（MDR）查找网格**，在**水深与建筑等级（`Kutcha`、`Semi-Pucca`、`Pucca`）的交叉点上给出物理损毁百分比**。**③ 计算引擎（Phase 3）**——**「有效水深」逻辑**：**从来水中减去每处房产的地坪高度**；**用嵌套 `INDEX`／`MATCH` 配合内联数组常量 `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}` 做二维数组查找**，**以绕开 Excel 表格对象对文本型数组的限制**。**④ 财务结构与仪表板（Phase 4）**——**超额赔款（XoL）再保引擎**：**对全部房产施加 5% 保额的免赔，用 `MAX(0, Ground_Up - Deductible)` 保证赔付有零下限**；**组合级再保摊回模块**，**自留额（Primary Retention）₹5,00,00,000、条约限额（Treaty Limit）₹20,00,00,000**；**用 Excel 数据表做多事件矩阵，让全部 8 个洪水情景（`FL_001` 至 `FL_008`）在 6 个区同时跑完**；**质量控制：对 `NORM.INV` 施加严格的下限约束（`MAX`），防止左尾极端值生成负的 TIV 并破坏下游财务计算**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「整个仓库就是一份 Excel 工作簿」是本条目最有价值也最罕见的一点**——**本站收录的巨灾与准备金工具几乎全是 Python／R／Julia 库**，**而**现实中大量精算工作确实在 Excel 里完成****；**这个仓库把这一点做到了极端：**没有代码，模型即工作簿****（**可与本站 [[actuarial-add-in-excel]]、[[eaa-excel-to-python-webinar]]、[[bread-excel-agent]]、[[excel-dna]] 所代表的 Excel 形态并读**）。⭐⭐ **对做建模的学生，它提供了一个**低成本可检视的完整巨灾链条样本**：**暴露 → 灾害 → 脆弱性 → 财务结构 → 风险指标**，**每一步都能在单元格层面看到**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张** Excel 适合承载生产级巨灾模型**——**规模、版本控制、审计与可复现性都有其局限**；**本次亦未打开该工作簿**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「用嵌套 `IFS` 强制逻辑成立的风险组合」是本条目最值得记的一处数据工程做法**——**逐字举例为**强制工业用途只能登记为 `Pucca` 结构并对应高端重置价值****；**即它把**现实中不可能的组合**（如工业厂房却是最脆弱结构）在数据生成阶段就排除掉**；**对做合成数据的同学，这比事后清洗更早一步**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其组合规则完整或符合任何真实建筑规范**——**本次未读其公式**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「二维 MDR 矩阵 + Kutcha／Semi-Pucca／Pucca 三级」是本条目在脆弱性建模上最具体的部分**——**水深 × 建筑等级的交叉点给出损毁百分比**，**这正是洪水脆弱性曲线的标准做法**；**而 `Kutcha`（非永久材料）、`Semi-Pucca`（半永久）、`Pucca`（永久／砖混）是**印度住房分类的实际术语****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其 MDR 取值来自任何权威来源**——**README 称其为「有代表性的」并「硬编码」，**本次未核实其出处**；**可与 [[hazus]]、[[gem-vmtk]] 等公开脆弱性方法并读**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「有效水深 ＝ 来水 − 地坪高度」是一条把**减灾措施**写进模型的朴素而正确的处理**——**地坪抬高在现实中就是防洪手段**，**而多数简化模型只用「水深」直接查表**；**把它显式写成一个减法步骤，说明作者理解物理量纲**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该处理足以刻画真实淹没过程**——**真实洪水还涉及流速、历时、泥沙与排水**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ 「内联数组常量 `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}` ＋ 嵌套 `INDEX`／`MATCH`」是一处**具体的 Excel 工程限制与绕法****——**逐字说明其目的是「绕开 Excel 表格对象对文本型数组的限制」**；**对必须用 Excel 做交付的精算同事，这类限制与绕法是**真实的日常约束****（**⚠️ 本次未打开工作簿验证该做法**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ 「自留额 ₹5,00,00,000 与条约限额 ₹20,00,00,000」被明确写下来，是本轮主题的典型形态**——**有了这两个数，读者才能核对**再保摊回与净自留损失**是怎么算出来的**；**而 `MAX(0, Ground_Up - Deductible)` 把**零下限**也写成了公式**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该分层结构对应任何真实条约**——**README 未说明其来源**；**可与 [[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[layerloss-locktonre]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] 并读**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 「用 `LARGE` 数组排名与经验概率公式 Rank/(N+1) 画净自留损失 EP 曲线」是本条目在风险指标上的做法**——**逐字称该图「完美展示了 ₹5 Crore 自留额上限在**高频小额事件**期间的**财务平坦化效应**」**；**`Rank/(N+1)` 是**经验超额概率**的标准估计式**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其曲线可用于任何真实的资本或再保决策**——**8 个情景 × 6 个区的样本规模极小**，**EP 曲线尾部的可靠性有限**；**此点为本词条的判断，非作者自述**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 「对 `NORM.INV` 施加下限约束以防负 TIV」是一处**质量控制**步骤**——**用正态分布生成总保额时，左尾会产生负值**；**作者在**生成阶段**就把它截住，**理由是负 TIV 会破坏下游财务计算**（**可与第 330 轮同批 [[catrisk-sim]] 的四条测试不变量（其中一条即「损失不能为负」）并读——**两者都在用**取值范围**这条最基本的性质做防错**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站巨灾与 Excel 条目并读**：[[catrisk-sim]]、[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]（**本轮同批的另两种做法**）、[[hazus]]、[[gem-vmtk]]、[[oasislmf]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[individualclaims-simulator]]、[[simulationmachine]]、[[excel-dna]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）****——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用、修改或再分发该工作簿前必须自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库根目录清单（仅两项）与 README（4,300 字节）全文的四个阶段描述**，⭐⭐⭐ **但**未打开、未下载、未运行那份 `.xlsx` 工作簿（**本次亦未打开其中任何公式、单元格、图表或数据表**）、未核对其公式是否如 README 所述、未运行其任何情景****，因此**不能转述其暴露数据的实际取值、灾害目录的具体事件参数、MDR 矩阵的实际数值、动态数组公式的写法、再保摊回公式的实现或任何计算数值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ README 中「1,000 处房产」「8 个情景（FL_001–FL_008）」「6 个区」「自留额 ₹5,00,00,000」「条约限额 ₹20,00,00,000」「5% 免赔」**等均为**作者自述**，**本次未在工作簿内核实**；**本词条**不主张**这些数值确实存在于工作簿中**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其 MDR 矩阵的取值来源**——**README 称其为「有代表性的」并「硬编码」**；**本词条**不主张**其与任何官方脆弱性曲线一致**（**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其灾害目录（重现期、年概率、最大水深）的来源与合理性**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「1,000 处房产」的暴露数据是否为**手工生成且仅为合成**（**README 明写 synthetic portfolio**）；**不主张**其可代表西孟加拉真实的财产暴露**；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **该仓库无任何代码、无测试、无版本化的计算逻辑****——**其全部计算逻辑都在一份二进制 `.xlsx` 内**，**这使**逐行审阅、版本对比与自动化测试**都变得困难**；**本词条据此**不主张**其过程可复现或可审计**（**此点为本词条的判断**）；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **GitHub 实测未识别出主语言（`None`）****，**与「模型即工作簿」的结构一致**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ 本模型为**教育／作品集性质****（**README 未声明其用途与限制**——**⚠️ 与其他候选不同，它**没有**写出范围免责声明**）；**本词条**不主张**其可用于任何真实的定价、核保、资本或再保决策**；**⑩ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑪ ⭐ README 4,300 字节、无 topics、无许可、无描述之外的元数据**；**⑫ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 4,300 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测核对，含四个阶段的逐字描述、`SEQUENCE`／`NORM.INV`／`RANDBETWEEN`／`IFS`／`INDEX`／`MATCH`／`LARGE`／`MAX` 等函数名、内联数组常量、两级再保金额与 EP 曲线做法）；**未打开、未下载、未运行该 `.xlsx` 工作簿**。
e.body_hk:
**west-bengal-flood-cat-model** 是一個**用進階 Excel 搭起來的端到端財產險洪水巨災模型**（倉庫 `Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、語言實測為 `None`（GitHub 未識別主語言）、體量 704 KB、創建於 2026-09-07、最後推送 2026-09-09**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件（`LICENSE` 於 main 分支實測 404）**、**無 topics**；**README 實測 4,300 位元組**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把假設寫成可核對的東西」**中的**第二種，也是載體最出人意料的一種：它的模型本體就是一份 Excel 工作簿**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫根目錄實測**）：**倉庫描述逐字**：**「Stochastic Catastrophe Flood Model for a synthetic West Bengal P&C portfolio」**。⭐⭐⭐ **根目錄實測只有兩項**：**`README.md`（4,300 位元組）與 **`West_Bengal_Flood_Catastrophe_Model.xlsx`（294,582 位元組）****——**即**這個倉庫裡沒有代碼，模型本體就是那份工作簿****。**README 開篇逐字**：**「Architecting an end-to-end Property & Casualty (P&C) catastrophe model in **Advanced Excel**. This project simulates ground-up flood losses for a **synthetic portfolio of 1,000 properties** across highly exposed districts in West Bengal, bridging theoretical actuarial concepts into an automated risk engine.」**。

**四個階段逐字實測**：**① 暴露資料工程**——Excel 動態陣列（`SEQUENCE`、`NORM.INV`、`RANDBETWEEN`）；**用嵌套 `IFS` 施加「邏輯受限的風險組合」**（**逐字舉例：強制工業用途只能登記為 `Pucca` 結構並對應高端重置價值**）；**納入地坪高度（英尺）與樓層數**；**TIV 按建築等級以正態分布圍繞現實重置成本建模**。**② 災害目錄與脆弱性矩陣**——**硬編碼代表性隨機洪水事件，含重現期、年概率與最大水深**；**二維平均損失率（MDR）查找網格**，在**水深與建築等級（`Kutcha`、`Semi-Pucca`、`Pucca`）的交叉點**給出物理損毀百分比。**③ 計算引擎**——**「有效水深」邏輯：從來水中減去每處房產的地坪高度**；**嵌套 `INDEX`／`MATCH` 配合內聯陣列常量 `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}` 做二維查找**，**以繞開 Excel 表格對象對文本型陣列的限制**。**④ 財務結構與儀表板**——**超額賠款（XoL）再保引擎**：**全部房產 5% 保額免賠，用 `MAX(0, Ground_Up - Deductible)` 保證零下限**；**組合級再保攤回模組，自留額 ₹5,00,00,000、條約限額 ₹20,00,00,000**；**用 Excel 資料表做多事件矩陣，讓全部 8 個洪水情景（`FL_001`–`FL_008`）在 6 個區同時跑完**；**質量控制：對 `NORM.INV` 施加下限（`MAX`）以防左尾生成負 TIV 並破壞下游財務計算**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「整個倉庫就是一份 Excel 工作簿」是最有價值也最罕見的一點**——**本站收錄的巨災與準備金工具幾乎全是 Python／R／Julia 庫**，**而**現實中大量精算工作確實在 Excel 裡完成****（可與 [[actuarial-add-in-excel]]、[[eaa-excel-to-python-webinar]]、[[bread-excel-agent]]、[[excel-dna]] 並讀；**⚠️ 不主張** Excel 適合承載生產級巨災模型**；**未打開該工作簿**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「用嵌套 `IFS` 強制邏輯成立」是資料工程上最值得記的一處**——**把**現實中不可能的组合**在**資料生成階段**就排除掉**，**比事後清洗更早一步**（**⚠️ 不主張**其組合規則完整或符合任何真實建築規範**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「二維 MDR 矩陣 + Kutcha／Semi-Pucca／Pucca 三級」是脆弱性建模上最具體的部分**——**水深 × 建築等級交叉點給出損毀百分比**，**正是洪水脆弱性曲線的標準做法**；**而三個等級是**印度住房分類的實際術語****（**⚠️ 不主張**其 MDR 取值來自任何權威來源**——**README 稱「有代表性」且「硬編碼」**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「有效水深 ＝ 來水 − 地坪高度」是一條把**減災措施**寫進模型的樸素而正確的處理**——**多數簡化模型只用「水深」直接查表**（**⚠️ 不主張**該處理足以刻畫真實淹沒過程**——**真實洪水還涉流速、歷時、泥沙與排水**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **「內聯陣列常量 `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}` ＋ 嵌套 `INDEX`／`MATCH`」是一處**具體的 Excel 工程限制與繞法****（**⚠️ 未打開工作簿驗證**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ 「自留額 ₹5,00,00,000 與條約限額 ₹20,00,00,000」被明確寫下，是本輪主題的典型形態**——**有了這兩個數，讀者才能核對再保攤回與淨自留損失是怎麼算出來的**（**⚠️ 不主張**該分層結構對應任何真實條約**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **「用 `LARGE` 陣列排名與經驗概率 Rank/(N+1) 畫淨自留損失 EP 曲線」**——**逐字稱該圖展示 ₹5 Crore 自留額上限在**高頻小額事件**期間的**財務平坦化效應****；**`Rank/(N+1)` 是**經驗超額概率**的標準估計式**（**⚠️ 本詞條判斷：8 個情景 × 6 個區樣本規模極小，EP 曲線尾部可靠性有限**——**此為本詞條判斷，非作者自述**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 「對 `NORM.INV` 施加上限約束以防負 TIV」是一處質量控制步驟**（可與同批 [[catrisk-sim]] 的四條測試不變量中「損失不能為負」並讀）。**⑨ ⭐ 可與 [[catrisk-sim]]、[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、[[hazus]]、[[gem-vmtk]]、[[oasislmf]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[individualclaims-simulator]]、[[simulationmachine]]、[[excel-dna]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 該倉庫實測**無任何許可文件****——**明確記錄並提示使用、修改或再分發該工作簿前自行確認授權**；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、根目錄清單（僅兩項）與 README 全文的四個階段描述**，⭐⭐⭐ **但**未打開、未下載、未運行那份 `.xlsx`（**未打開其中任何公式、儲存格、圖表或資料表**）、未核對其公式是否如 README 所述、未運行其任何情景****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ README 中「1,000 處房產」「8 個情景」「6 個區」「自留額 ₹5,00,00,000」「條約限額 ₹20,00,00,000」「5% 免賠」等均為**作者自述****，**未在工作簿內核實**，**不主張**這些數值確實存在於工作簿中**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**其 MDR 矩陣取值來源**，**不主張**其與任何官方脆弱性曲線一致**（**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其災害目錄（重現期、年概率、最大水深）的來源與合理性**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其暴露資料是否為手工生成且僅為合成**，**不主張**其可代表西孟加拉真實的財產暴露**；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ 該倉庫**無任何代碼、無測試、無版本化的計算邏輯****——**全部計算邏輯都在一份二進位 `.xlsx` 內**，**使逐行審閱、版本對比與自動化測試都變得困難**；**不主張**其過程可複現或可審計**（**此點為本詞條的判斷**）；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ GitHub 實測未識別主語言（`None`）**，**與「模型即工作簿」的結構一致**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ 本模型為**教育／作品集性質****（**⚠️ 與同批其他候選不同，它**沒有**寫出範圍免責聲明**）；**不主張**其可用於任何真實的定價、核保、資本或再保決策**；**⑩ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**不主張成熟度／正確性／已被採用**；**⑪ ⭐ README 4,300 位元組、無 topics、無許可**；**⑫ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`、`/readme` 與 `/contents/` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未打開、未下載、未運行該 `.xlsx` 工作簿**。

**west-bengal-flood-cat-model** is **an end-to-end property flood catastrophe model built in Advanced Excel** (repository `Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, a language measurably reported as `None` (GitHub detected no primary language), a 704 KB repository, created 2026-09-07 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` returned 404 on main)** and **no topics**; **the README measures 4,300 bytes**. It is the second of this round’s four takes on **writing assumptions into something a reader can check**, **and its carrier is the most unexpected: the model itself is an Excel workbook**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): **the repository description reads verbatim**: **"Stochastic Catastrophe Flood Model for a synthetic West Bengal P&C portfolio"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **The root measurably contains exactly two items**: **`README.md` (4,300 bytes) and `West_Bengal_Flood_Catastrophe_Model.xlsx` (294,582 bytes)** — **there is no code in the repository; the model itself is that workbook**, **which is why GitHub detects no primary language**. **The README opens verbatim**: **"Architecting an end-to-end Property & Casualty (P&C) catastrophe model in Advanced Excel. This project simulates ground-up flood losses for a synthetic portfolio of 1,000 properties across highly exposed districts in West Bengal, bridging theoretical actuarial concepts into an automated risk engine."**

**Its four phases read verbatim**: **① Exposure data engineering** — Excel dynamic arrays (`SEQUENCE`, `NORM.INV`, `RANDBETWEEN`); **nested `IFS` imposing logic-bound risk combinations** (**the README’s own example: forcing industrial occupancies to register only as `Pucca` construction with correlating high-end replacement values**); plinth height in feet and number of stories modelling ground-level inundation; TIV modelled with normal distributions around realistic replacement costs by construction class. **② Hazard catalog and vulnerability matrix** — hardcoded representative stochastic flood events with return periods, annual probabilities and maximum water depths; **a two-dimensional mean damage ratio (MDR) lookup grid** giving physical damage percentages at the intersections of **water depth and construction class (`Kutcha`, `Semi-Pucca`, `Pucca`)**. **③ The calculation engine** — an "effective depth" logic that **subtracts each property’s plinth height from the incoming water**; **nested `INDEX`/`MATCH` with the inline array constant `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}`** to **bypass the text-string limitations of native Excel tables**. **④ Financial structuring and dashboard** — an **excess-of-loss reinsurance engine**: **a 5%-of-TIV deductible on every property with `MAX(0, Ground_Up - Deductible)` enforcing a zero floor**; a portfolio-level recovery module with **Primary Retention of ₹5,00,00,000 and a Treaty Limit of ₹20,00,00,000**; **an Excel Data Table multi-event matrix running all 8 flood scenarios (`FL_001` to `FL_008`) across 6 districts at once**; and **quality control applying a floor (`MAX`) to `NORM.INV` so extreme left-tail draws cannot create negative TIV and break the downstream financial calculations**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ That the entire repository is one Excel workbook is the entry’s most valuable and rarest point** — **the catastrophe and reserving tools collected here are almost all Python, R or Julia libraries**, **whereas a great deal of real actuarial work is in fact done in Excel**; **this repository takes that to its limit: no code, the model is the workbook** (**readable with the Excel-form entries [[actuarial-add-in-excel]], [[eaa-excel-to-python-webinar]], [[bread-excel-agent]] and [[excel-dna]]**). ⭐⭐ **For a modelling student it offers a low-cost, inspectable sample of a complete catastrophe chain — exposure, hazard, vulnerability, financial structure, risk metrics — with every step visible at cell level** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim Excel is suitable for a production catastrophe model — scale, version control, audit and reproducibility all have limits; and this workbook was not opened**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Enforcing logic-bound risk combinations with nested `IFS` is the entry’s most notable data-engineering practice** — **the README’s own example forces industrial occupancies to register as `Pucca` with correlating high-end replacement values**, **excluding combinations that cannot exist in reality at the data-generation stage rather than after the fact** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its combination rules are complete or match any real building code — its formulas were not read**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The two-dimensional MDR matrix with three construction classes is the entry’s most concrete vulnerability modelling** — **damage percentages at the intersection of depth and construction class is exactly the standard form of a flood vulnerability curve**, **and `Kutcha`, `Semi-Pucca` and `Pucca` (non-permanent, semi-permanent, permanent) are the actual Indian housing classification terms** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its MDR values come from any authority — the README calls them representative and hardcoded, and their provenance was not verified; readable with public vulnerability methodologies such as [[hazus]] and [[gem-vmtk]]**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ "Effective depth = incoming water − plinth height" is a plain and correct way of modelling a mitigation measure** — **raised plinths are a real flood defence**, **whereas most simplified models look up damage from water depth alone**; **writing it as an explicit subtraction shows the author understands the physical quantities** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim this captures real inundation, which also involves velocity, duration, sediment and drainage**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ The inline array constant `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10}` with nested `INDEX`/`MATCH` is a concrete Excel engineering limit and workaround** — **stated verbatim as bypassing the text-string limitations of native Excel tables** (**⚠️ the workbook was not opened to verify it**). **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Retention of ₹5,00,00,000 and a treaty limit of ₹20,00,00,000 are written down explicitly, the typical form of this round’s theme** — **with those two figures a reader can check how recovery and net retained loss were derived** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the structure matches any real treaty — the README does not state its source; readable with [[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]], [[layerloss-locktonre]] and [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Drawing the net retained loss EP curve with `LARGE` array ranking and the empirical `Rank/(N+1)` formula** — **described verbatim as showing the financial flattening effect of the ₹5 Crore retention cap in high-frequency attritional events**; **`Rank/(N+1)` is the standard empirical exceedance-probability estimator** (**⚠️ this entry’s own judgement, not the author’s: with 8 scenarios across 6 districts the sample is very small and the reliability of the curve’s tail is limited**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Applying a floor to `NORM.INV` to prevent negative TIV is a quality-control step** (**readable with the four test invariants in this round’s [[catrisk-sim]], one of which is that losses cannot be negative — both use the simplest property of a range as an error trap**). **⑨ ⭐ Readable with [[catrisk-sim]], [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]] (this round’s other two approaches), [[hazus]], [[gem-vmtk]], [[oasislmf]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[individualclaims-simulator]], [[simulationmachine]] and [[excel-dna]]**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` returned 404 on main)** — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before using, modifying or redistributing the workbook**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, the two-item root listing, and the README’s full 4,300 bytes describing the four phases**, ⭐⭐⭐ **but did not open, download or run that `.xlsx` workbook (no formula, cell, chart or data table in it was opened), did not check whether its formulas match the README, and did not run any scenario**, so **its actual exposure values, the concrete event parameters of its hazard catalog, the actual MDR figures, the dynamic-array formulas, the recovery implementation and any computed value cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The README’s "1,000 properties", "8 scenarios (FL_001–FL_008)", "6 districts", "₹5,00,00,000 retention", "₹20,00,00,000 treaty limit" and "5% deductible" are all the author’s own account and were not verified inside the workbook**; **the entry does not claim those figures are actually present in it**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Where its MDR matrix values come from was not verified** — **the README calls them representative and hardcoded**; **the entry does not claim they match any official vulnerability curve** (**the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**); **⑤ ⭐⭐ The provenance and plausibility of its hazard catalog (return periods, annual probabilities, maximum depths) were not verified**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ Whether its exposure data is hand-generated and synthetic was not verified beyond the README saying the portfolio is synthetic**; **it is not claimed to represent real West Bengal property exposure**; **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ The repository has no code, no tests and no version-controlled calculation logic** — **all of it lives inside a binary `.xlsx`**, **which makes line-by-line review, version comparison and automated testing difficult**; **the entry therefore does not claim the process is reproducible or auditable** (**this is the entry’s own judgement**); **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ GitHub detects no primary language (`None`), consistent with a model that is a workbook**; **⑩ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑪ ⭐ A 4,300-byte README, no topics and no licence**; **⑫ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Kit-ty8/West-Bengal-Flood-Catastrophe-Model`, `/readme` and `/contents/` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 4,300-byte README read via `raw.githubusercontent.com`, with the four phases, the function names `SEQUENCE`/`NORM.INV`/`RANDBETWEEN`/`IFS`/`INDEX`/`MATCH`/`LARGE`/`MAX`, the inline array constant, the two reinsurance amounts and the EP-curve method checked verbatim);
